rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Steep, narrow street with homes 7-17 m away and no stopping room.
reasons: Narrow lane, tree-lined, no parking convention

drivers.seclusion: Houses and pools line both sides, most within 7-17 m of the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with trees and fences close to the edge; little level ground to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; only a couple of cars parked near the downhill end.

flags: Steep: 9% mean, 19% max; about 14% at the downhill end
Dwellings within 10-17 m along the stretch
Sandy Creek 221 m away, low-lying not an issue (min 36 m)
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the middle; open to the sun at the downhill end.
